Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Account mapping question — Epsilon / ConsultCo overlap

Sergio / Laura —

Epsilon Tech just replied to our partner intro and the account list they shared overlaps with several named accounts in the ConsultCo integration pipeline (see excerpt below). Before I loop in Partnerships and the SE team, can we decide the default routing policy for these joint accounts?

Quick context: ConsultCo is a certified integration partner (reseller & systems integrator) and has an active opportunity in our pipeline for three of the Fortune 500 accounts on Epsilon's list; Epsilon claims local PS relationships at two of them and wants direct SDR/AE engagement.

Questions:
- Preferred ownership model for accounts in the overlap (partner-led vs. Redwood-led)?
- If partner-led, what minimum involvement from Redwood (SE attachment / joint exec sponsor)?
- Does Reserved Dedicated customers or existing contracts change routing?

I captured the overlaps in a quick CSV draft (rdw-eps-routing-proposal.csv) and flagged high-risk accounts. Attaching for review. Can you both review and propose a one-line routing rule we can send to Partnerships + legal for exceptions?

Thanks —
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partner GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Account mapping question — Epsilon / ConsultCo overlap

Thanks for the heads up, Tessa. Saw the CSV — good call flagging the three co-sold accounts. My initial take:

- Default: partner-led routing for accounts where the partner has an active engagement and a signed SOW in the past 12 months. That keeps ConsultCo's motion intact and respects their PS footprint.
- Exception: If the account is on Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) or has an active pilot signed directly with Redwood, route to Redwood AE but require SE-involved joint kickoff.
- Escalation: Any account where the partner asks for exclusivity should go to Partnerships + Sales VP for final decision; require a documented MA P&L (mutual action plan).

One-line rule suggestion for Partnerships: "If partner has signed SOW or active PS engagement in last 12 months -> partner-led; else -> Redwood-led with mandatory SE joint kickoff for any pilot/POC. Exceptions require VP approval."

Jordan / Laura — thoughts on operationalizing (HubSpot ownership flags, opportunity tags, required checkbox on PSC form)? I can prep a short rule set for the playbook once we align.

- Sergio

--
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Director, Alliances & Partners
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Account mapping question — Epsilon / ConsultCo overlap

Tessa / Sergio —

Appreciate you reaching out. Quick notes from our side: we shared the account list to be transparent; Epsilon's commercial motion is to land PS-led POCs in markets where we have local delivery capacity. We're happy to follow whatever routing keeps deal momentum.

Attached is our Q2 account extract (Epsilon_Accounts_Q2.xlsx) with notes on which accounts have current engagements. For the three accounts referenced, we have local PS contracts at two and a proposal pending on the third.

We're open to a partner-led flow as long as a Redwood SE can be booked for the technical kickoff and the roadmap alignment session. If you prefer Redwood-led for the pilot, we'll require a clear SLA for handback to Epsilon for expansion.

Let us know which rule you'll implement and we'll surface it to our salesops.

Thanks —
Alex Turner
Head of Partnerships, Epsilon Tech

Attachment: Epsilon_Accounts_Q2.xlsx (xls, 214KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Account mapping question — Epsilon / ConsultCo overlap

Adding operational detail — I mapped the accounts in the CSV and proposed HubSpot field updates. Summary:

- Tag opportunities with partner_source = {consultco | epsilon} and partner_status = {active_sow | prior_sow | no_sow}.
- If partner_status == active_sow -> set owner to partner queue; create automatic task to schedule SE-attached kickoff (14 day SLA).
- If partner_status == prior_sow and ACV > $200k -> route to Redwood AE but mark joint-expansion partner.

I've attached rdw-eps-routing-proposal.csv with the flags. A couple of edge cases: Account "Omega Utilities" is under a long-term procurement contract that requires vendor-level coordination (legal wants to see copy of SOW). Recommend Partnerships + Legal run a quick clearance for that one.

Camila — can your team add the partner_source and partner_status fields to HubSpot by next Wednesday? Jordan — can you confirm that Sales Ops can enforce the 14-day SE kickoff task? If yes, I'll draft the playbook language and the customer-facing routing note.

Laura
